# @three-ws/react

> React components for embedding three.ws 3D AI agents

@three-ws/react is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/react`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-react/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-react/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-react/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-react/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents

## Project

- [Source](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-react)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/react)
- [three.ws](https://three.ws): the platform this is part of
